en.name: Mullet
en.summary: Grey mullet is an oily fish caught off Taiwan in the winter, when the females carry the roe that becomes karasumi. From purchase the flesh keeps 1–2 days in the fridge and 2–3 months in the freezer.
en.pantry: Mullet has no room-temperature life. It is an oily fish and it also feeds on the bottom, which means the gut contents are strong and the fish goes off from the inside outwards if it is not cleaned. Take a cool bag, get it home fast, and follow the 2-hour rule, or 1 hour if it is above 32 °C (90 °F). In winter mullet season the fish is often sold straight off the boat; that is the best possible start, and it is wasted by an hour in a warm car.
en.fridge: Keep it at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, gutted, on ice, in a container that catches the melt water, and cook it within 1–2 days from purchase. Have the stall gut it and remove the gills on the day — a mullet left ungutted develops a muddy, bitter taste quickly, and the belly is the first part to soften. Store it on the bottom shelf, below anything ready to eat, and keep it covered because an oily fish perfumes a fridge.
en.freezer: Mullet keeps 2–3 months at −18 °C (0 °F), which is the short freezer window that goes with an oily fish: the fat oxidises long before lean flesh would. Freeze it as gutted whole fish or as fillets, wrapped tightly with no air pockets or ice-glazed by dipping in cold water first, flat and in single portions. Frozen food stays safe indefinitely at −18 °C; the months are about quality. The roe is a separate product with its own storage rules.
en.thawing: Thaw in the fridge overnight on a plate, or in a sealed bag under cold running water. Never on the counter or in warm water. Cook it promptly and do not refreeze raw fish.
spoilage: A sour, ammoniacal or strongly muddy smell rather than a clean sea one.
Flesh that stays dented when pressed instead of springing back.
Cloudy sunken eyes and grey-brown gills on a whole fish.
A rancid, paint-like smell and a yellow cast along the belly.
tips: Have it gutted and gilled at the stall; mullet turns muddy fast if left whole.
Take a cool bag; boat-fresh fish is easily wasted on the way home.
Freeze in single portions the day you buy it.
Keep it covered — an oily fish flavours everything near it in the fridge.

faq.q: How long does mullet keep in the fridge?
faq.a: 1–2 days from purchase at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, gutted and on ice.
Yes, 2–3 months at −18 °C. It is oily, so wrap it tightly or ice-glaze it and use it within the window.
It is a bottom feeder, and the flavour comes from the gut and the gills. Gutting it on the day you buy it makes a large difference.

faq.q: Is mullet roe stored the same way?
faq.a: No. Salted, dried mullet roe is a different product with its own rules and should not be judged by these figures.

zh.name: 烏魚
zh.summary: 烏魚是冬季洄游到台灣海域的油脂魚，母魚身上的卵巢就是烏魚子的原料。魚肉本身從購買日起冷藏可放 1～2 天，冷凍 2～3 個月。
zh.pantry: 烏魚沒有室溫保存這回事。牠含油，又是底棲攝食的魚，腸道內容物味道重，沒清理的話會從裡面開始壞。請帶保冷袋盡快回家，並守 2 小時原則，室溫超過 32 °C 時為 1 小時。烏魚季常常是船一靠岸就直接賣，那是最好的起點，卻很容易被悶熱車上的一小時毀掉。
zh.fridge: 去內臟後鋪冰，放 4 °C 以下，容器要能接住融水，並在購買後 1～2 天內煮掉。請當天就請攤商去內臟、去鰓——整條沒清理的烏魚很快就會出現土味和苦味，而腹部是最先變軟的部位。放最下層、位置低於即食食品，並且要加蓋，因為油脂魚會把整個冰箱染味。
zh.freezer: 烏魚在 −18 °C 下可放 2～3 個月，這正是油脂魚該有的短區間：脂肪氧化得遠比瘦肉快。可以整條去內臟冷凍，也可以切片，包緊不留空氣或先浸冷水做冰鍍，分成單份壓平。−18 °C 下安全性是無限期的，月數講的是品質。魚卵是另一種產品，保存規則也不同。
zh.thawing: 放盤子上冷藏隔夜解凍，或密封裝袋用冷水沖。不要放室溫或泡溫水。解凍後盡快烹調，生魚不要再次冷凍。
spoilage: 聞起來發酸、有氨味或強烈土味，而不是乾淨的海味。
按壓後凹陷回不來，而不是有彈性。
整條魚眼睛混濁凹陷、魚鰓轉灰褐。
腹部泛黃並帶油耗、油漆般的氣味。
tips: 請攤商當場去內臟去鰓；整條放著很快就有土味。
帶保冷袋；船邊現撈的新鮮度很容易在路上浪費掉。
買回來當天就分成單份冷凍。
務必加蓋——油脂魚會讓冰箱裡所有東西都帶味。

faq.a: 去內臟鋪冰、放 4 °C 以下，從購買日起 1～2 天。
可以，−18 °C 下 2～3 個月。它含油，請包緊或做冰鍍，並在期限內用完。
牠是底棲攝食的魚，味道主要來自內臟和鰓。買回來當天就清理，差別非常大。

faq.q: 烏魚子的保存方式一樣嗎？
faq.a: 不一樣。鹽漬日曬的烏魚子是另一種產品，有自己的規則，不適用這些數字。
